notes.en: Aimed for unified shoulder and hip junctions so the background raised arms and spread legs emerge naturally behind the foreground pose, generous gold silhouettes with tiered aged-ink contours and subtle diagonal pen hatching that simplify cleanly down to 38px, and natural hands and classical facial features free of stripes, forks, or cartoon expressions. Still weak: below 38px the narrow inner gap between the standing legs merges into a single column and the hair curls darken slightly, while at 700px the raised-arm deltoid transition and spread feet remain lightly modeled compared to a full pen study.
